nativeJob.failure: After a successful SettingsButton tap, the first SettingsRoot hierarchy expectation was issued while DrawerRoot was still mounting and never returned; the 15-minute case deadline expired before native wallet setup.

observations: The launch blacklist was present before app launch and the app connected to Detox.
WalletsList and SettingsButton were visible; the tap returned successfully and the app logged navigation to DrawerRoot.
The SettingsRoot request began immediately during the slow transition, remained pending, and the retained failure frame still shows the fresh empty wallet home screen.
No recovery, send, replacement preparation, signing or broadcast assertion ran or failed.

boundedCorrection.detail: On iOS only, allow the already-successful Settings tap a bounded 12-second transition interval before issuing the unchanged SettingsRoot assertion. Android and every wallet action remain unchanged.
